name: Québec.ca
body: llms.txt is published, Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors, and every image has alt text. But home page links carry tabindex values like 20 and 25, so keyboard users move in an order that skips around.
lesson: Remove positive tabindex values and order the HTML the way people should move through it.
summary: www.quebec.ca scores 90 out of 100 (A). 0 checks fail now, 11 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: other sites can frame the page.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Positive tabindex reorders the keyboard path
fix.fix: Use tabindex="0" or the natural order.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: 4 titles run past about 60 characters
fix.fix: Lead with the words that matter and keep titles near 60 characters.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 374 ms
Every page has a meta description
